note: the graded episode's service (graded_service.py): public constants only; the hidden episode is episode.json, which only the worker reads. cell_sha256 pins online/cell/, which setup.sh fills from the root-only staged payload (byte copies of tests/jar_sim.py, jar_render.py, jar_look.json, jar_env.py and episode.py, the grader's simulator, cameras and episode logic). env is the grader's environment (the image's ENV and tests/test.sh's MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE; the worker also runs the image's numerics pin module again). prep_s is the agent's budget on main ([agent] timeout_sec 7200): the episode must be started within it; graded_s is the window from the start to the episode's latest end. The dual mode's freeze (DM3): at the graded start, or when the start window closes without one, the root supervisor copies submission_dir into record_dir/snapshot_name (no link followed, only what the agent's account owns; snapshot_max_files and snapshot_max_bytes are main's caps, 5000 files and 200 MB; entries and depth bounded so that the copy finishes and stays within the engine's artifact limits).
